verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides a single programmatic endpoint for Microsoft cloud data, and there is a documented user-list API, so Entra objects are clearly reachable through an API. Nothing in the pack shows that every admin-center capability (Conditional Access, entitlement management, lifecycle workflows, device management, diagnostic settings) can also be done through Graph. The SCIM API covers only provisioning into apps. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, documented Graph coverage of governance, Conditional Access and device admin features, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
